messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: nocturnal thermoregulation issue now fixed
parts:
Hi everyone,

As I was putting the shiny apps together I noticed an issue with the way nocturnal behaviour was occurring. There was a bug that was making them come to the surface at night as long as they were above the critical thermal minimum. This issue is now fixed in the latest version of the package on github.

Apologies.

All the best,
Mike

messages.author: a05ad4db1ef329a2
messages.subject: Re: nocturnal thermoregulation issue now fixed
parts:
Hi Mike,

Just to clarify, does that mean that when running the Ectotherm model before for just nocturnal activity the animals were ONLY coming to the surface if they were below their CTmin? Or was I misinterpreting that statement?

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: nocturnal thermoregulation issue now fixed
parts: Sorry Vinny - should have said 'above' not 'below'! I'll edit that post. The main consequence would have been that they would have had lower temperatures at night due to being on the surface even though it was below the basking temp (T_B_min) in cases where they would be above the CT_min on the surface.
